place.instructions: `shot` describes one shot from the film Finch. Where does this shot take place?

criteria.desert: outdoors in open desert, wasteland, dirt road or sandstorm away from buildings
criteria.city: outdoors among city streets, buildings, overpasses, parking lots or bridges
criteria.vehicle_cab: inside the cab of a truck or car (not the RV living area)
criteria.rv: inside the RV / motorhome (cockpit or living area)
criteria.shelter: inside Finch's shelter base: the tech company building, workshop, lab, corridors, decontamination room, shower, bedroom
criteria.other_building: inside some other building such as a store, house, hotel, theater or warehouse
criteria.none: none of these, or the place cannot be told

finch_look.instructions: `shot` describes one shot from the film Finch. How does Finch (the man) appear in this shot?

criteria.suit: wearing his protective suit and/or helmet
criteria.shirtless: shirtless or bare-chested, e.g. washing or showering
criteria.clothes: in ordinary clothes such as a t-shirt, shirt, jacket or coat
criteria.absent: Finch is not in the shot
criteria.none: none of these, or it cannot be told
